sections.title: Contemporary Issues in Human Sexuality and Health
sections.description: Emphasizes the theories of sexual development and sexual behavior within the continuum of health and disease. Common sexual practices of people are studied in relation to life-style and/or situational life crisis. Contemporary issues in sexuality and health will be examined. Prerequisite: Junior and Senior Undergraduates. Open to all graduate students This course satisfies the Society & Social Structures Sector for Nursing Class of 2012 and Beyond.
